title: DoseRow becomes tappable
name: DoseRow
description: DoseRow has no tap handling at all today. Adds an onClick parameter and a clickable modifier so tapping a dose opens the new edit flow (wired in DailyListScreen).
acceptance_criteria: New parameter: onClick: () -> Unit, placed after doseLog and before the existing modifier parameter
The Row's modifier chain gains .clickable(onClick = onClick)
Everything else (border, padding, Column/Text content) is unchanged
